text: Customizes Random Affixes of Vorax Gear.
Grafting can be performed on Vorax Gear at [Mad Doctor Shelley] in the Town to customize random affixes on gear.
Use Normal Organs to add Basic or Advanced affixes to Vorax Gear.
Use Special Organs to add Ultimate affixes to Vorax Gear.
Use Core Organs and Sutures to add Legendary affixes to Vorax Gear. The Core Organs of some Legendary gear can only be Grafted to high-level Vorax Gear.
During Grafting, affix options will be provided based on the number of affixes on the corresponding Legendary gear.
The Legendary affixes of a Vorax Gear must come from the same Legendary gear.
Legendary gear with 2 affixes provides 1 affix option, while Legendary gear with more than 2 affixes provides 2 affix options.
Each piece of Vorax Gear can have up to 2 Advanced affixes, 2 Ultimate affixes, and 2 Legendary affixes.
Use Cutting Instruments to re-roll the values of all random affixes of Vorax Gear.
When a piece of Vorax Gear already has a certain Ultimate affix, the corresponding Special Organ can't be Grafted on it again.
When Grafting with some Special Organs there is a chance for a Blemish to appear.
When a piece of Vorax Gear has 2 Legendary affixes, Core Organs can no longer be Grafted onto it.
The Grafting system allows you to add affixes to Vorax Gear.
Use Normal Organs to add Basic or Advanced affixes to Vorax Gear.
Use Special Organs to add Ultimate affixes to Lv. 89 or above Vorax Gear.
Use Core Organs and Sutures to add Legendary affixes to Vorax Gear. The Core Organs of some Legendary gear can only be Grafted to high-level Vorax Gear.

During Grafting, affix options will be provided based on the number of affixes on the corresponding Legendary gear. Legendary gear with 2 affixes provides 1 affix option, while Legendary gear with more than 2 affixes provides 2 affix options.
The Legendary affixes of a Vorax Gear must come from the same Legendary gear.
